name: Suidobashi
tagline: Otemachi in 5 minutes and Tokyo in 11 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥130,000 to ¥140,000.
summary: The station is in Chiyoda City, served by JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) and Toei Mita Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 5 minutes to Otemachi, 17 minutes to Shinjuku, 23 minutes to Shibuya and 25 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. The station stands 4.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 21.3 m. The land around the station rises and falls sharply.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 4.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 1.4 m to 22.7 m, a difference of 21.3 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 4 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 1 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 21 clinics and 18 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 東京歯科大学水道橋病院, about 153 m away and 飯田医院, about 420 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) and Toei Mita Line. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 1 line and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 57.

rentRange.note: One room ¥130,000 to ¥140,000, 1K ¥140,000 to ¥150,000, 1LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000 and 2LDK ¥320,000 to ¥330,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.note: 631 m away in a straight line. It takes 3 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Suidobashi. One-room rents run about ¥26,000 lower.
678 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Suidobashi. One-room rents run about ¥7,000 lower.

People who want to finish their shopping on foot

People who would rather not walk up and down slopes

leads.terrain: The ground around the station rises and falls sharply, and living above or below the slope changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 11 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 6 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
